text_en: I myself, Paul, appeal to you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—I who am humble when face to face with you, but bold toward you when I am away! —
text_cn: 我保禄 ──就是那在你们中面对面时就谦卑，不在的时候就对你们胆大的──亲自藉基督的温和良善劝告你们，

text_en: I ask that when I am present I need not show boldness by daring to oppose those who think we are acting according to human standards.
text_cn: 甚至求你们，不要叫我到你们那里时，因果敢而对你们大了胆──这种果敢，本来是我决意要对付那些，以我们为按照血肉行事的人的──

text_en: Indeed, we live as human beings, but we do not wage war according to human standards;
text_cn: 我们固然是在血肉中行事，却不是按照血肉而交战，

text_en: for the weapons of our warfare are not merely human, but they have divine power to destroy strongholds. We destroy arguments
text_cn: 因为我们作战的武器，不是属于血肉的，而是凭天主有力的武器，足以攻破坚固的堡垒：攻破人的诡辩，

text_en: and every proud obstacle raised up against the knowledge of God, and we take every thought captive to obey Christ.
text_cn: 以及一切为反对天主的智识所树立的高寨，并掳获一切人的心意，使之服从基督；

text_en: We are ready to punish every disobedience when your obedience is complete.
text_cn: 并且我们已准备停当，及至你们完全服从时，来惩罚一切的不服从。

text_en: Look at what is before your eyes. If you are confident that you belong to Christ, remind yourself of this, that just as you belong to Christ, so also do we.
text_cn: 你们看看摆在眼前的事实吧！如果有人自信是属于基督的，他自己该再想想：他怎样属于基督，我们也怎样是；

text_en: Now, even if I boast a little too much of our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for tearing you down, I will not be ashamed of it.
text_cn: 因为，即便我对我们的权柄有一点过分的夸耀──这权柄原是主所赐与，为建树，而不是为破坏你们的──我也不羞愧，

text_en: I do not want to seem as though I am trying to frighten you with my letters.
text_cn: 免得有人以为我好像只会藉着书信来恐吓你们。

text_en: For they say, “His letters are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible. ”
text_cn: 因为有人说：“他的书信的确严厉而又强硬，但他本人在时却软弱无能，言语又空洞可轻。”

text_en: Let such people understand that what we say by letter when absent, we will also do when present.
text_cn: 这样的人该想一想：我们不在的时候，写信时在言语上是怎样，我们来到的时候，在行事上也必是怎样。

text_en: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But when they measure themselves by one another, and compare themselves with one another, they do not show good sense.
text_cn: 其实，我们不敢拿自己与某些举荐自己的人同列或相比；他们是以自己来度量自己，以自己来跟自己相比，这决不是明智。

text_en: We, however, will not boast beyond limits, but will keep within the field that God has assigned to us, to reach out even as far as you.
text_cn: 我们夸耀却不越过范围，而只是按照天主所指给我们的界限范围，照这范围也一直达到你们那里。

text_en: For we were not overstepping our limits when we reached you; we were the first to come all the way to you with the good news of Christ.
text_cn: 我们并没有过于伸展自己，好像从没有到达过你们那里似的；其实，是我们先带着基督的福音，到了你们那里的；

text_en: We do not boast beyond limits, that is, in the labors of others; but our hope is that, as your faith increases, our sphere of action among you may be greatly enlarged,
text_cn: 我们并没有越过了范围，以别人的劳苦而夸耀；我们只希望因着你们信德的长进，在你们中按照指给我们的界限越发开展，

text_en: so that we may proclaim the good news in lands beyond you, without boasting of work already done in someone else’s sphere of action.
text_cn: 以致将福音传到你们以外的地方，但不在别人的界限内，以别人已成的事而夸耀。

text_en: “Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord. ”
text_cn: “凡要夸耀的，应当因主而夸耀。”

text_en: For it is not those who commend themselves that are approved, but those whom the Lord commends.
text_cn: 因为不是自己举荐自己的，那人是可取的，而是天主所举荐的。
